newsitem.title: GERMANY: Futura launches new Germany to Gambia flights.
newsitem.headline: Futura launches new Germany to Gambia flights.

text.p: Futura International Airways has started four flights a week from Germany to Gambia, German package holiday operator CA Ferntouristik said.
Futura, a subsidiary of Irish national carrier Aer Lingus, is flying from Berlin, Cologne, Munich and Frankfurt to the Gambian capital, Banjul, with a Boeing B737-400 aircraft.
CA Ferntouristik said it expected to fly 14,500 passengers to the African state up to the end of October.
It had also bought extra seat capacity from Belgian airline Sabena on its services to Gambia to meet high demand for the destination, it added.
Futura International Airways has a fleet of nine Boeing 737-400 aircraft with a seating capacity of 170 passengers.
